name: Rome
reflections: You walked where senators argued and emperors passed — and Rome let you in.
The living city opened its piazzas, fountains, and evening light to you.
Twenty centuries folded into one walk. You crossed them on foot.
Some chapters remain ahead — Rome keeps a seat for your return.

waypoints.name: The Colosseum

reconstruction.caption: Evidence-based reconstruction · awning colours are informed conjecture

waypoints.approachLine: The amphitheatre rises ahead — slow your pace and look up.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Take a second. / Look up.

waypoints.name: Palatine Hill
waypoints.approachLine: The emperors' hill is just ahead.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Rome was born here — breathe it in.

waypoints.name: Arch of Titus

reconstruction.caption: Evidence-based reconstruction · relief details simplified for clarity

waypoints.approachLine: The Forum opens — Titus' arch marks the threshold.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Stand where triumph entered the city.

waypoints.name: Basilica of Maxentius
waypoints.approachLine: Vaulted halls loom through the columns ahead.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Imagine the roof still whole above you.

waypoints.name: Via Sacra
waypoints.approachLine: You're walking the Sacred Way — keep to the stones.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Processions passed here for a thousand years.

waypoints.name: Temple of Vesta
waypoints.approachLine: The round temple is just ahead.
waypoints.arrivalLine: The flame that guarded Rome burned here.

waypoints.name: The Rostra
waypoints.approachLine: The speakers' platform is near — listen for echoes.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Orators once held Rome from this spot.

waypoints.name: Temple of Saturn
waypoints.approachLine: Eight columns stand ahead — the treasury temple.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Gold and grain once moved through these doors.

waypoints.name: Curia Julia
waypoints.approachLine: The Senate house is just ahead.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Decisions that shaped an empire were made here.

waypoints.name: Arch of Septimius Severus
waypoints.approachLine: The triple arch closes the Forum's north end.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Victory in stone — still legible after centuries.

waypoints.name: Capitoline Hill
waypoints.approachLine: Climb toward the hill where Rome's gods watched over the city.
waypoints.arrivalLine: The capitoline — heart of public faith.

waypoints.name: Trajan's Market
waypoints.approachLine: Brick arcades stack ahead — Rome's great market hall.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Shops and offices once hummed in these halls.

waypoints.name: The Pantheon

reconstruction.caption: Evidence-based reconstruction · portico bronze finish is informed conjecture

waypoints.approachLine: The rotunda appears through the streets — you'll feel it before you see the oculus.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Two thousand years of sky through one opening.

waypoints.name: Circus Maximus
waypoints.approachLine: The long green bowl opens — Rome's chariot track.
waypoints.arrivalLine: A quarter million voices once roared from these banks.

waypoints.name: Piazza del Popolo
waypoints.approachLine: Day Two begins at the people's square — the twin churches ahead.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Rome's northern gate opens onto the city.

waypoints.name: Spanish Steps
waypoints.approachLine: The steps rise ahead — take them slowly.
waypoints.arrivalLine: A staircase built for seeing and being seen.

waypoints.name: Fontana di Trevi
waypoints.approachLine: You'll hear the fountain before you see it.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Throw a coin if you wish — the water doesn't mind.

waypoints.name: Largo di Torre Argentina
waypoints.approachLine: Sacred ruins below street level — cats and columns.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Four temples in one sunken square.

waypoints.name: Campo de' Fiori
waypoints.approachLine: The market square opens — morning or evening, always alive.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Flowers, fruit, and four centuries of chatter.

waypoints.name: Piazza Navona
waypoints.approachLine: Bernini's fountain plays ahead — the stadium shape beneath your feet.
waypoints.arrivalLine: A racetrack turned piazza — Rome's living room.

waypoints.name: Castel Sant'Angelo
waypoints.approachLine: Hadrian's tomb rises beside the river.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Emperor, fortress, refuge — one stone silhouette.

waypoints.name: Appian Way
waypoints.approachLine: The basalt stones stretch south — the queen of roads.
waypoints.arrivalLine: Walk where legions and merchants left Rome.
